text:
jordan: Heads-up — after the kernel selection change landed yesterday I'm seeing periodic latency oscillations on PP 1F1B runs. waves every ~11-13 microbatches.
meera: Yikes. Can you paste a perf summary? which job/cluster?
jordan: job=pp-stage-14, 8-way pipeline, microbatch=4. attaching quick datapoints from profiler.
perf-bot: automated snapshot -> job=pp-stage-14; rank_summary={r0: avg_step=12.3ms, r1: 12.1ms, r2: 18.7ms, r3: 12.4ms}; allreduce_avg=4.1ms; kv_prefetch_hit=68%; kv_evictions=1.9% 
samir: rank 2 looks like the outlier. allreduce avg is up ~2x vs baseline. Could be compute skew or a kernel fallback on that rank.
olivia: I also saw increased kernel_launch_time for matmul2 on odd GPUs after the selector change: launch ~0.9ms -> 2.6ms when seq>512 :thinking:
meera: If one rank takes longer compute, it delays the allreduce queue and the pipeline bubble grows — classic comm/compute overlap regression.
jordan: suspect chain: new kernel choice -> slower matmul on some kernels -> kv_prefetch window not tuned -> prefetch eviction -> memory stalls -> slower compute -> bigger allreduce waits.
samir: Agreed. Quick mitigation ideas: 1) pin matmul kernel to legacy on affected model/seq 2) increase KV prefetch window to reduce evictions 3) tweak microbatch schedule (microbatch=2 instead of 4) to shorten bubble
olivia: for experiments I can spin a run with kernel_pin=matmul:legacy and KVPREFETCH_WINDOW=96. want me to try before changing scheduler?
jordan: please try kernel pin + prefetch first. if that doesn't fix, do microbatch size change.
meera: note: the kernel selector also switched a heuristic for seq>512. maybe we need to add a fallback threshold rather than blanket selection.
olivia: kicking off run now: `rlctl run --job pp-stage-14-patch --env KVPREFETCH_WINDOW=96 --env KERNEL_PIN=matmul:legacy --microbatch=4`
perf-bot: deploy started -> tracking pp-stage-14-patch. will post a summary at end.
(measurement after 12 mins)
perf-bot: snapshot -> job=pp-stage-14-patch; rank_summary={r0:11.9ms, r1:12.0ms, r2:12.5ms, r3:12.1ms}; allreduce_avg=1.9ms; kv_prefetch_hit=88%; kv_evictions=0.4%
jordan: nice — allreduce halved and rank skew gone. prefetch hit up a lot. seems kernel pin + larger window fixed it.
samir: That suggests kernel selection produced a slower path on some ranks. For a longer-term fix: we should update the selector to prefer the low-launch kernel when it reduces end-to-end step latency, not just FLOP efficiency.
meera: +1. Also add an adaptive prefetch window metric in the profiler UI (kv_hit rate + eviction trend) so we can detect this earlier.
olivia: I'll open a PR to add a selector fallback and a flag to annotate per-kernel launch latency in the model profile. keeping microbatch at 4 for perf baseline.
jordan: also propose an automated canary that runs 1F1B with varied seq lengths when we roll kernel selector changes.
samir: I'll draft the canary job and a short runbook: 1) if allreduce_avg increases >1.5x or kv_eviction>1% -> auto rollback. 2) alert channel eng-runtime
meera: sounds good. small follow-up: add a note to changelog about selector heuristic change and mitigation knobs.
ojordan: thanks all — great triage. :thumbsup:
